headline.en: Filter search results before opening every link.
headline.zh: 点开链接之前，先筛掉命中规则的结果。

sub.en: CleanSERP applies local heuristics to rendered Baidu search results and hides matching cards while showing a filtered-result count.
sub.zh: 净搜对已渲染的百度搜索结果应用本地启发式规则，隐藏命中的卡片，并显示过滤数量。

body.en: Visible result fields are classified without an API call.
body.zh: 无需 API 调用即可分类可见结果字段。

body.en: Matching results carry a specific rule category.
body.zh: 命中结果带有具体规则类别。

body.en: A content script works in the existing Baidu result view.
body.zh: content script 直接作用于已有百度结果页。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The standalone example includes three complete synthetic result objects and runs the production classify function.
note.zh: 独立示例包含三条完整合成结果对象，并运行生产 classify 函数。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Three explicit synthetic search results run through the production rule classifier; this does not measure live search quality or browser DOM behavior.

body.en: The standalone example includes three complete synthetic result objects and runs the production classify function.
body.zh: 独立示例包含三条完整合成结果对象，并运行生产 classify 函数。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/cleanserp.git
cd cleanserp
npm ci
npm run build

limitations.en: Rules are heuristics. Labels such as baijiahao-ai-slop name a rule category; they do not prove that an author used AI or that a page is inaccessible.
limitations.zh: 规则属于启发式判断。baijiahao-ai-slop 等标签是规则分类，不证明作者使用 AI，也不证明页面无法访问。

limitations.en: The shipped manifest targets Baidu. Sogou and store publication are not established by this demo.
limitations.zh: 随仓 manifest 面向百度；本示例不代表已支持搜狗或已在扩展商店上架。

limitations.en: The offline example tests the production classifier on synthetic inputs, not live DOM compatibility or search quality.
limitations.zh: 离线示例在合成输入上运行生产分类器，不验证实时页面兼容性或搜索质量。

body.en: Search snippets already contain signals such as promotion labels, login prompts and redirect links. CleanSERP uses those visible signals to reduce repeated checking, with rules that developers can inspect and adjust.
body.zh: 搜索摘要中已有推广标记、登录提示和跳转链接等信号。净搜根据这些可见信息减少重复筛选，规则可以直接检查和修改。

body.en: The content script extracts result fields and calls the pure classify function. Matching cards are hidden and the count is published to the extension UI. The manifest currently injects scripts into Baidu pages; the type definition alone does not enable another engine.
body.zh: content script 提取结果字段并调用纯函数 classify，隐藏命中卡片，再把计数传给扩展界面。当前 manifest 只向百度页面注入脚本；类型定义出现其他引擎并不等于已支持。

body.en: The content script extracts result fields and calls the pure classify function. Matching cards are hidden and the count is published to the extension UI. The manifest currently injects scripts into Baidu pages; the type definition alone does not enable another engine.
body.zh: content script 提取结果字段并调用纯函数 classify，隐藏命中卡片，再把计数传给扩展界面。当前 manifest 只向百度页面注入脚本；类型定义出现其他引擎并不等于已支持。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Edit src/content/rules.ts to change local matching rules, rebuild, then reload the unpacked extension. No account is required. The extension requests storage permission and Baidu host permissions.
body.zh: 修改 src/content/rules.ts 调整本地匹配规则，重新构建后重载已解包扩展。无需账号；扩展申请 storage 与百度站点访问权限。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
npm run build
# Load dist/ in chrome://extensions (Developer mode).
npm run typecheck
npm test
